items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: We had a trumpet player named Sidney DeParis... Well, Sidney played trumpet, and we had another trumpet player... Don found this out, and this is the way he featured him.

ctx.x: Yes. He had an excellent clarinetist and saxophonist -- alto saxophonist that is -- and he's a very good friend, a guy out of Detroit named Edward Inge -- I-N-G-E. Excellent clarinetist, and my tenor player was Bob Carroll out of Louisville, Kentucky, he went onto the band, and the other saxophonist was a foreigner, a little guy named Rupert Cole. This is what we called him, anyway. His last name was Cole. -- five. That constituted the reed section. We had a trumpet player named Sidney DeParis, one of the DeParis…
